title: PulseDeck × Gamma Production Acceptance — Rehearsal Kit

cards.title: PulseDeck × Gamma Production Acceptance
cards.text: 10-minute rehearsal kit. Certify synchronization before a live training.

cards.title: Pre-flight readiness
cards.text: Confirm extension 0.4.1, secure controller pairing, Gamma version baseline and standby readiness.

cards.title: Signal or noise?
cards.prompt: Which signal should a QI team investigate first?
options: A sustained shift across eight observations

cards.title: Neutral transition
cards.text: Confirm the poll closes and the PulseDeck panel disappears before continuing.

cards.title: Confidence check
cards.prompt: How confident are you that you can distinguish common-cause from special-cause variation?

cards.title: First response
cards.prompt: Rank the actions after a concerning data signal.

cards.title: Boardroom language
cards.prompt: In one word, what makes a QI chart credible?

cards.title: Facilitation prompt
cards.prompt: What is one question you would ask before acting on this chart?

cards.title: Rapid navigation test
cards.text: Press Next, Back, then Next quickly. The final visible Gamma card must be authoritative.

cards.title: Production question
cards.prompt: Submit one production-readiness question from the audience device.

cards.title: Controller resilience
cards.text: Verify primary control, standby takeover and the mobile Remote priority window.

cards.title: Acceptance complete
cards.text: Record PASS or HOLD before using the live training deck.
